what: Resolution 68-2026 adopts Local Law No. 5 of 2026, which adds a Battery Energy Storage System Law (new Chapter 58) to the town code and changes the zoning chapter (165) to match. The law sets rules on where battery storage can go and how it is built and run, with Tier 1 (up to 600 kWh) and Tier 2 (over 600 kWh) systems.
next: If adopted, the Town Clerk files the law with the NY Secretary of State, publishes an abstract in the official newspaper and posts it on the town sign board.

what: Local Law E of 2026 would stop the development, construction or use of new commercial cryptocurrency mining operations, data mining, data processing centers and data storage facilities anywhere in the Town of Marcellus for twelve months. The law exempts projects already approved or on Town-owned property, but they could not be expanded while it lasts.
where: All real property within the Town of Marcellus
who: Town Board of the Town of Marcellus
next: An enactment vote on Local Law E is on the same agenda, under New Business.
history: Introduced at the Sep 16 Town Board meeting; also on the Oct 7 Town Board agenda.
line: 12-month moratorium on data centers and crypto mining, Local Law E: hearing
quote: Public Hearing: Local Law E of 2026 Twelve (12) Month Moratorium on Commercial Cryptocurrency Mining Operations, Data Mining, Data Processing Centers, and Data Storage Facilities Within the Town of Marcellus
missing: The meeting place is not printed for this workshop meeting (the other meetings listed are at Town Hall). The draft resolution leaves the mover and seconder blank. Relief requests carry a $250.00 filing fee; violations a fine up to $1,000.00 or up to 15 days in jail, or both.

what: After the public hearing, the Town Board has a resolution to enact Local Law E of 2026, the twelve-month moratorium. The draft resolution calls the law a Type II action under SEQR, which ends environmental review, and says it went to the Onondaga County Planning Board for review.
where: All real property within the Town of Marcellus
who: Town Board of the Town of Marcellus
next: The law takes effect immediately upon passage and lasts twelve months, unless renewed or ended sooner by Town Board resolution.
history: Introduced at the Sep 16 Town Board meeting; also on the Oct 7 Town Board agenda.

what: Cortlandt CSG LLC, an affiliate of Bullrock Renewables, asks the Town Board to extend for one year its special permit and site development plan approval for a solar facility on Lexington Avenue at Route 202. The approved project, under Planning Board Resolution 8-22, is an approximately 2.3 MW solar energy system with about 5,300 panels on a parcel of about 33 acres west of Lexington Avenue and north of Crompond Road, and would remove about 2,000 regulated trees.

size: Approximately 2.3 MW; approximately 5,300 solar panels; parcel of approximately 33 acres
